blocks.text: NEW YORK—Taylor Swift has announced a new song, “Patient Zero”—her first since her starry wedding this summer. It releases Friday, Sept. 25. She made the announcement in true Swift fashion. On Tuesday morning, Sept. 22, the pop powerhouse launched a cryptic countdown clock on her website, displayed atop a red curtain and due to end at 2 p.m. Eastern. Her dedicated fans, known as Swifties, quickly got to work attempting to decode whatever news was forthcoming, noting that her official Instagram bio was changed to read “And, baby, that’s sh0w business f0r y0u,” with each “o” replaced with a zero.
